{{Recipe}}

'''Dodo''' is a [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Nigeria|Nigerian]] dish of fried ripe plantain. It is often served with jollof rice, rice and beans, and beans porridge.

==Ingredients==
*4 ripe [[Cookbook:Plantain|plantains]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] puréed chile pepper mixed with tomatoes
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]]

==Procedure==
#Cut each ripe plantain into 6 small pieces. [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] with salt and chile-tomato purée to taste.
#Heat ½ cup of oil in a [[Cookbook:Skillet|frying pan]]. Add the 6 plantain pieces, and [[Cookbook:Deep frying|deep fry]] until all sides are golden brown.
#Serve with jollof rice or bean porridge.
